prompts.snap-home: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a radically new, original TRAIL WARS Roblox game UI. This is a fresh direction named SNAP ARCADE, not a recolor of puffy peach/plum menus. Design a beautiful polished modern family arcade interface with sharp art direction, game-like immediacy and expressive simplicity. New palette: pale mint #DFF4E8, warm white #FFFCF3, midnight blue ink #192A46, vibrant coral #FF6957, cornflower #5877E8, small marigold #F4CE54 accents. Graphic flat-to-lightly-layered 2D surfaces, short crisp offset shadows, 2–3px ink outlines, modest 12–20px corners, perfectly circular core tokens. No glossy pill buttons, no clay bevels, no giant cream picture frame, no stretched textures, no peach/plum, no neon cyberpunk, no charcoal/yellow minimalist dashboard, no sports-poster diagonal lettering. Typography is upright bold rounded geometric sans, confident and highly readable, carefully spaced. A new original TRAIL WARS wordmark in ink with a short curved route motif, do not reuse an existing logo. This is actual top-down core/trail survival: automatically moving circular cores turn left/right and leave smooth continuous wall trails; last survivor wins. No humans, cars, weapons, avatars, humanoids, abilities, joystick, racing track, lootbox, battle pass, daily rewards or invented systems. Show precise independent smooth curves with one core at the endpoint of each path. No path branching through a core, no invalid trail crossings. Dynamic text is real legible type. Frame-filling actual UI mockup, no physical monitor or device, no collage, no explanatory annotations outside the interface. Small footer 'DESIGN PROPOSAL · SAMPLE DATA'. One full-resolution 1920x1080 DESKTOP HOME. Thoughtful three-zone composition: compact original wordmark upper left and small '480 COINS' counter upper right; a welcoming hero cluster of simple core-token/trail shapes on a large OPEN warm-white playfield occupying central/right area (no heavy frame); strong left action column with huge CORAL rectangular PLAY button and concise 'LAST CORE STANDING' line. Four clearly subordinate navigation buttons CUSTOMIZE, SHOP, PROFILE, SETTINGS in a tidy bottom strip with simple ink symbols. Play must be unmistakably primary. No scrolling and no hidden navigation. Lots of breathing room without empty dashboard boxes. Arena diagram feels like the actual game in motion, thin clean cornflower/coral/honey paths and small outlined ring core tagged YOU. Preserve strong aspect ratios, compact purposeful art, all controls naturally proportioned, delightful micro-details such as a small route bend and a crisp press-shadow. The interface should look as if a professional game art director designed it from scratch, cheerful but never childish clutter.
